title: BN k222 v1 case: changing nfreq shifts the whole GW window, growing with energy
symptom: First live evolution round (run-20260912T132957Z-53d93fb1e0, everything else frozen): KS bands bit-identical, EXX within 4e-05 eV, but GW states shift monotonically with state index - occupied top ~0.30 eV, mid window 1-9 eV, top state 50.0 eV; only states 5/6 stay put. The raw window is itself unhealthy: QP orderings cross (state 8 below state 7), states reach +212 eV, and a naive whole-window 'gap' is negative. Clean follow-ups (post merge-fix, single-variable, KS bit-identical and EXX invariant in every round): nfreq 16->24 moves the near-gap GW VBM by 0.319 eV (run-20260913T114024Z ledger /tmp/evolve-bn-nfreq24.json) - the SAME magnitude as 16->8. Decisive: nfreq 8 and 24 AGREE with each other within 0.04 eV while both differ from 16 by ~0.3 eV (VBM state 4 per k: 16->[10.921, 8.061, 5.966], 8->[10.998, 7.756, 5.683], 24->[10.999, 7.748, 5.647]). The frequency grid is NOT a convergence axis here; 16 sits on an outlier branch relative to its neighbors.
root_cause: Unknown mechanism; NOT a grid-resolution convergence signature (convergence would shrink steps). Two live hypotheses: (a) the default analytic-continuation/model definition couples to nfreq so each grid is a different definition; (b) the 16-point minimax grid sits outside its validated scaling region on this stack. Pinning n_params_anacon through librpa.in is IMPOSSIBLE on the old-gen stack: the v0.7.0-dd169fa input layer does not parse the key (only compute_g0w0.cpp/options.cpp use it, API-level), so the definition probe needs a new-generation stack or an API-level driver.
minimal_fix: Do not scan nfreq on this case until the definition is pinned. All recorded diffs belong to the 16->8 direction. Accept near-Fermi states only (window states 3-8); treat the full window as a diagnostic, not an acceptance criterion. A controlled nbands 26->30 probe tests whether adding empty states disturbs the near-gap window at all. Round C (nfreq 32) classifies the branch: 32 joining the 8/24 branch marks 16 as the outlier and the frozen reference must be re-frozen on the majority branch.
validation: KS bit-identity and EXX invariance prove single-variable control; near-gap window diffs are the acceptance metric. Re-evaluate after pinning whatever definition axis the mechanism investigation identifies.
avoid: Attributing the shift to a specific mechanism (e.g. Pade order) without a controlled test; comparing whole windows containing anomalous high states; treating the old reference window as physical acceptance material.
source: First live evolution round 2026-09-12/13, df pinned stack, ledger /tmp/evolve-bn-run13.json + snapshot state-wise analysis.
